recognize_zh: 這是一張 PCR 洋菜膠電泳圖，不是型態學影像：陽性對照（P）與骨髓移植後 0、5、7、17、26、38 個月的檢體都在 120 bp 處出現同一條亮帶，陰性對照（N）沒有，表示標的序列在移植後持續可測得。
features: Ethidium bromide-stained agarose gel photograph; non-morphologic
Positive control (P) shows a strong band at 120 bp; negative control (N) is blank
Samples at 0, 5, 7, 17, 26 and 38 months after BMT all show a band of the same 120 bp size
Faint smaller bands below the main product in several lanes, most likely primer-dimer or nonspecific products
Target sequence is not labeled on the figure; in the context of ATLL it presumably represents HTLV-1 proviral DNA or a clone-specific marker
describe_en: Agarose gel electrophoresis of PCR products is shown with a positive control, a negative control, and serial post-transplant samples. A 120 bp amplicon matching the positive control is present at every time point from 0 to 38 months after bone marrow transplantation, while the negative control shows no product. Band intensity is roughly similar across time points, although this end-point assay is not quantitative. The target is not labeled in the image; in the setting of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, the findings indicate persistent detection of the target sequence (presumably HTLV-1 provirus) after transplantation.
